description: The schema fix in BUG-535 made DeepSeek invocation reliable again, but current limits are hardcoded compact values and cannot safely exercise DeepSeek's larger context window without code changes or ad hoc edits.
expected: Nightly design-drift and silent-degradation audits expose explicit configurable LLM budget tiers. The expanded tier can request up to 80K input characters/tokens equivalent budget and 40K output tokens when the provider/model allows it; compact remains the default unless config/CLI opts in. The audit payload records requested tier, effective limits, max_output_tokens, truncation counters, and provider usage. Provider failures or budget exhaustion remain visible and do not silently fall back to deterministic conclusions.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
title: Nightly DeepSeek audit should support configurable 80K input and 40K output budget

recommendations: Use compact success output; request full JSON only for failures or diagnostics.
